subject: English
stimulus: (a) A poet is a man who ⎯⎯. (b) If I had been you, ⎯⎯. (c) It was many years ago since ⎯⎯. (d) Write quickly lest ⎯⎯. (e) He talked as if ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) A poet is a man who can turn his imagination into writing/can turn beauty into poetry. (b) If I had been you, I would have gone there. (c) It was many years ago since we had last met. (d) Write quickly lest you should not finish the exam in time. (e) He talked as if he had known everything.
